thread:
alex (AE): FYI customer says their POC credits evaporated mid-demo. They expected ~30k tokens for the session but our usage UI shows 120k. Acme is blocked on approval. Can someone triage? :confused:

mira (SE): which project/account? streaming or non-streaming? any request ids or example timestamps?

alex (AE): account_id=51234, project=acme-poc-2026, timeframe 2026-03-12 13:45-14:10 UTC. They were using the streaming chat endpoint with moderate chunking. Customer says the UI counted multiple chunks twice.

sam (Billing): I'm on it. pulling usage for account 51234 now. can you paste a sample request id if they have one? I'll grep logs for streaming_chunk_recount.

katie (Support): also checking alerting — were spend alerts configured? sometimes they set thresholds on bytes not tokens.

alex (AE): they gave one request id: req_6f4a9c. They say the response retried once because of a client reconnect.

mira (SE): reconnect + streaming retries could trigger double-count in older SDKs. Did they use the node SDK v0.9?

alex (AE): yes, they were on node v0.9.2 (we recommended v1.x but POC had an internal policy).

sam (Billing): found matching logs. snippet:

```
2026-03-12T14:02:03Z account=51234 project=acme-poc-2026 req=req_6f4a9c event=stream_chunk tokens=12000
2026-03-12T14:02:03Z account=51234 project=acme-poc-2026 req=req_6f4a9c event=stream_chunk tokens=12000 (retry)
2026-03-12T14:02:04Z account=51234 project=acme-poc-2026 total_tokens=120000 note=streaming_chunk_recount_v1
```

sam (Billing): looks like streaming_chunk_recount_v1 feature flag double-counted chunks when a retry occurred. This was gated but mistakenly enabled for the sandbox namespace used by POCs.

mira (SE): ok that explains it. does this affect only token accounting or also quota enforcement?

sam (Billing): token accounting only — quota enforcement checks the raw request counter separately so they weren't actually over their paid quota, but the UI and billing preview showed inflated usage. I'll prepare an adjustment.

katie (Support): and alerting — i checked their project, alert rule was: metric=network_bytes, threshold=100MB. so it never fired. we should suggest a tokens-based alert template for POCs.

sam (Billing): proposed fix: issue a corrective credit for the inflated tokens and flip the feature flag off for sandbox projects. I'll run a one-off correction job and post the audit id here.

sam (Billing): action: issued credit txn_credit_77821 for 90000 tokens (~$36). audit_id=adj_20260312_01. Also toggled streaming_chunk_recount_v1 -> OFF for namespace=poc-sandbox.

mira (SE): created a short note in the POC runbook about using SDK v1.x for streaming stability and to enable tokens-based alerts. I'll link it in the customer handoff.

katie (Support): updated the alert template: created rule tokens_consumed > 25000 within 1h -> notify #sales-alerts and email acme-poc-admin. rule_id=alert_9912.

alex (AE): thanks everyone. I'll loop the customer and confirm they see the credit and corrected numbers. can we also get a clear sentence for them to share with their compliance folks?

sam (Billing): reply you can send: "We identified a counting bug affecting streaming retries in the sandbox POC namespace. We applied a corrective credit (audit id adj_20260312_01) and disabled the feature flag for POC projects. Your actual consumed tokens were lower; billing preview has been corrected."

alex (AE): perfect. sending now. please ping if anything else shows up on other POCs.

deploy-bot: feature flag streaming_chunk_recount_v1 disabled for namespace poc-sandbox by sam (Billing) at 2026-03-12T14:06:12Z

katie (Support): follow-up: i'm scheduling a quick KB for AE/SEs about common POC billing gotchas (streaming retries, SDK versions, alerts). target publish EOD tomorrow.

alex (AE): awesome, closing this thread once the customer confirms. :thumbsup:
